animation.origin: right to left (inactive collapses right, expands left on hover)

linkActive.indicator: underline via pseudo-element at full width

characterDescription: An architectural navigation drawn from formal institutional codes — uppercase micro-typography at 0.08em letter spacing opens the letterforms into measured, inscriptional spacing without reaching for display scale. The 0.875rem size increase gives the nav links a slightly more present voice in the composition while preserving their subservient role beneath the editorial serif headings. Hairline underline animations wipe in right-to-left on hover and hold full width on active state. Transition timing aligned to 0.26s base duration. Typography inherits from the assembled type system.

_twist.description: Nav link fontSize increased from 0.75rem to 0.875rem (+0.125rem at intensity 3). lineHeight adjusted proportionally from 0.8125rem to 0.9625rem. Letter spacing 0.08em and uppercase transform preserved. No color changes.
